background_choices.description: POV walk along a resort path

recent_story_cards.conflict: The narrator knows someone is taking their food but has no proof until the thief exposes herself by complaining about the meal.
recent_story_cards.payoff: You filed a complaint about food you stole.
recent_story_cards.premise: A coworker secretly steals the narrator's homemade lunches for a week, then reports the narrator to HR after taking a naturally extra-spicy meal.
recent_story_cards.title: She Stole My Lunch, Then Reported Me to HR
recent_story_cards.twist: The coworker identifies herself as the lunch thief by filing an HR complaint about food that was never hers.

recent_story_cards.conflict: The narrator becomes convinced a hidden jewelry purchase means a proposal is coming, while her boyfriend acts increasingly secretive and keeps disappearing to make mysterious calls.
recent_story_cards.payoff: I should have told you the truth years ago.
recent_story_cards.premise: A woman thinks her boyfriend is secretly planning to propose after finding a hidden jewelry receipt, but discovers he bought an expensive bracelet for his mother to replace one he accidentally lost years ago.
recent_story_cards.title: I Thought He Was About to Propose
recent_story_cards.twist: The jewelry was never an engagement ring; he was replacing his mother's sentimental bracelet after finally admitting he lost the original years earlier.
